altamira.title: Altamira · Real Estate
altamira.description: An auteur real estate site built as an SPA. Catalog filters live in the URL, so a search is shareable and survives refresh. Behind it all runs a video sequence tied to scroll without slowing loading.
altamira.alt: Home of Altamira Real Estate site: hero with property search and featured grid

oscuroCafe.title: Oscuro Café - Specialty Coffee
oscuroCafe.description: A premium landing page for a specialty coffee shop designed to convey warmth and sophistication. The experience combines fluid animations and a visual narrative that invites you to discover the story behind each cup of coffee, while highlighting products and services.
oscuroCafe.alt: Home of Oscuro Café site: hero with coffee image and featured products grid
